title: Teacher asks for two or three ways to reteach equivalence before any draft
turnSequence: Teacher asks the app for two or three ways to reteach equivalent fractions, with tradeoffs, before any drafting.
The app should present the options, compare relevant tradeoffs, and wait for a choice.
expected: An approach-comparison stage exists in the generation workflow: the server exposes options with tradeoffs and holds drafting until the teacher chooses.
observableFailure: The app drafts immediately without offering or comparing approaches, or invents a comparison that does not exist.
flipCondition: Unblocks when an approach-comparison stage exists in the generation workflow (options plus tradeoffs plus wait-for-choice before drafting).
